source: P01.168 A1 (the rule of size as a line of the form of the rule of error)
removed: - Only for a body refusal the optional field `size` is admitted: if it is present, it is the integer JSON number of the full size of the sent body, not a string and not a boolean. After it is checked it is excluded from the comparison with `expect`. The absence of `size` is admissible by N2; other additional fields, `key` included, are not admitted (the common rule of `error` is kept). For a weight refusal the fields `key` and `size` are mandatory and are compared as before.
